name: @velor/remote-mouse
description: Remote mouse and keyboard with mobile client

scripts.test:vm: VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant VAGRANT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=libvirt vagrant up --no-provision linux-install && VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant vagrant rsync linux-install && VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant vagrant provision linux-install && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --config jest.vm.config.js --runInBand
scripts.test:vm:x11: VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant VAGRANT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=libvirt vagrant up --no-provision linux-x11 && VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant vagrant rsync linux-x11 && VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant vagrant provision linux-x11 && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --config jest.x11.config.js --runInBand
scripts.test:vm:windows: VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant VAGRANT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=libvirt vagrant up --no-provision windows-11 && VAGRANT_CWD=dev/vagrant vagrant provision windows-11
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:integration
